kpis.description_fr: ASKs (Available Seat Kilometers). Capacité IAG (BA + Iberia + Aer Lingus + Vueling + LEVEL). Recovery 2024 vs 2019 pre-COVID.
kpis.description_en: ASKs (Available Seat Kilometers). IAG capacity (BA + Iberia + Aer Lingus + Vueling + LEVEL). 2024 recovery vs 2019 pre-COVID.

kpis.description_fr: PRASK = passenger revenue / ASK. Pricing power 2024 post-COVID demand strong. Premium cabin demand particularly strong (BA + Iberia first/business).
kpis.description_en: PRASK = passenger revenue / ASK. 2024 pricing power strong post-COVID demand. Premium cabin demand especially strong (BA + Iberia first/business).

kpis.description_fr: Load Factor. Above 85% solid IAG history. Stable demand strong.
kpis.description_en: Load Factor. Above 85% solid IAG history. Stable strong demand.

kpis.description_fr: Membres Avios + IAG Loyalty (British Airways Executive Club + Iberia Plus + Aer Lingus AerClub). Plus haute marge revenue ancillary.
kpis.description_en: Avios + IAG Loyalty members (British Airways Executive Club + Iberia Plus + Aer Lingus AerClub). Higher margin ancillary revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Levier post-COVID reset. Return cash to shareholders (dividend resumption 2024 + €350M buyback). Premier post-COVID retour cap.
kpis.description_en: Post-COVID reset leverage. Return cash to shareholders (2024 dividend resumption + €350M buyback). First post-COVID cap return.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition Air Europa €350M (LatAm long-haul Madrid hub). EU approval Q1 2025 + remedies. Boost Madrid hub LatAm gateway #1.
kpis_story.description_en: Air Europa €350M acquisition (Madrid hub LatAm long-haul). Q1 2025 EU approval + remedies. Boosts Madrid hub #1 LatAm gateway.

kpis_story.description_fr: Demande Premium first/business class boom post-COVID (corporate retour + ultra-HNW leisure). BA London-NY route world's most profitable.
kpis_story.description_en: Premium first/business class boom post-COVID demand (corporate return + ultra-HNW leisure). BA London-NY route world's most profitable.

_notes: IAG.L = International Airlines Group (BA + Iberia + Aer Lingus + Vueling). Modèle hub-and-spoke London/Madrid + Avios loyalty premium.
